q: How do I reset my password?
answer: To reset your password, go to the sign-in page and click "Forgot password." We will email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan is $4 per month.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan is $8 per user per month. For 5 users, it would be $40 per month. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: On the free plan, you can keep up to 100 notes. If you need more, consider upgrading to Plus or Team.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: You can get a refund within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Unfortunately, refunds are only available within 14 days of purchase. You don't qualify for a refund now.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: Sorry, but there is no Linux desktop app; Linux users can use the web app. If you need further assistance, you can open a support ticket.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Example Notes supports Android 12 or later. For older versions, you can use the web app.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: Sorry, the web app needs a connection. The mobile and desktop apps work offline.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: To export all notes as PDF, go to Settings > Export. Select "PDF" and request the export. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: You can recover deleted notes from the Trash for up to 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: Sorry, we don't support SMS codes for two-factor authentication. You'll need to use an authenticator app.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum attachment size on the free plan is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep Plus features until the end of the current billing period. To cancel, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States. If you need more details, you can open a support ticket.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We aim to reply within one business day. If you don't hear back soon, please open a support ticket.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20%. Please check your subscription settings for more details.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With the Plus plan, you can use it on up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't know if we offer a student discount. Please open a support ticket to inquire further.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. You can open a support ticket for this.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. You can open a support ticket for this request.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: Sorry, I don't know when a Linux desktop app will be released. You can open a support ticket for more information.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: Sorry, I can't provide that information. If you need help with Example Notes, feel free to ask!

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: Sorry, but I can't answer that. If you need help with Example Notes, just let me know!

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan provides shared workspaces.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team plans, the file size limit is 250 MB per file.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインインページで「パスワードを忘れた」をクリックしてください。リセットリンクをメールで送りますが、30分で期限切れになります。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: Sorry to hear about your experience. If your notes were deleted, they stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore". If not, you don't know and can open a support ticket.
